=== step 6: dashcrew "worktree" "watch" "--interval" "abc" "--once"
exit: 64
stdout: (empty)
stderr:
| --interval must be a positive number of seconds.
| 
| Usage: dashcrew worktree watch [<name>...]
| -h, --help         Print this usage information.
| -p, --project      Any folder inside the repository.
|                    (defaults to ".")
|     --once         Run one pass and exit.
|     --state-dir    Where seen events are kept; defaults to <git dir>/dashcrew-watch.
|     --interval     Seconds between passes.
|                    (defaults to "60")
| 
| Run "dashcrew help" to see global options.
